absent: Locking discipline and concurrency rules for descriptor table updates.
Interrupt and preemption safety of debug register save and restore sequences.
Full contents of the CPUID table beyond the first two base leaves.
Runtime semantics of cross dossier helpers for masks percpu access and memory copy.

findings.text: Extended capability leaf organizes four 32 bit register images in architectural order. The first image packs many single bit reports about nested breakpoints segment base handling fence behaviour paging lock selector clearing address ignore mitigation controls short string speed store forwarding workload hints and predictor security with reserved gaps between defined bits. The second image holds a wide microcode size value plus a narrower predictor size value. Remaining images are entirely reserved.

Monitoring leaf uses the first image for three single bit version and freeze reports with the rest reserved. The second image encodes counter counts and stack depth with narrow unsigned fields for core northbridge and memory controller groups. The third image is a full width active unit mask. The fourth image is entirely reserved.

Protected memory leaf carries a single mode flag in the first image and a wide total key count in the second image. All other bits in the first two images and all bits in the last two images are reserved.

Topology subleaf encodes level width plus hybrid and ranking flags in the first image, logical count plus efficiency ranking plus model and type codes in the second image, level identity plus domain kind in the third image, and full local APIC identity in the fourth image. Reserved gaps separate defined fields within the first three images.
Topology subleaves span an inclusive index range from zero to three.

Vendor base leaf stores a maximum leaf value plus vendor name shards across the remaining images. The following leaf encodes stepping model family and processor kind codes plus four single byte revision components plus nominal frequency plus recovery and power management flags, with most feature bits in the last image reserved.

One leaf carries processor and firmware revision identities spread across its images. Four companion leaves each contribute four full width shards of a contiguous identification string covering successive byte ranges, together forming a long readable name.
Operating point leaf reports present frequency voltage performance share and switching delay as four full width unsigned values, one per register image.

Compatibility base leaf carries only a maximum leaf value with all other images reserved. The next leaf leaves its first three images reserved and packs paired availability and enablement reports for cipher random hash multiply voltage thermal and asymmetric capabilities in its final image with reserved gaps.
Generic result block holds four unsigned register images in fixed order. A companion index orders those positions from zero to three for programmatic selection.
Well known base functions use small selectors five nine thirteen twenty one twenty two and twenty nine for wait direct cache extended state timestamp frequency and tile discovery.
Range helpers align a selector down to its sixty four kilobyte family base and compute the inclusive family ceiling. Base family starts at zero and ends at its computed ceiling.

Descriptor decoding models only the top validity flag of each register image and ignores the rest. A union exposes the same sixteen bytes as four flag views or four raw values or sixteen byte descriptors.

Cache kinds enumerate first level instruction first level data second and third levels starting at one in packed form. Translation kinds continue after the cache maximum and distinguish instruction data and shared entries by page size groupings in packed form. A decode entry pairs one kind choice with either a capacity or a count through two overlapping unions.
One architectural descriptor has a fixed translation count of thirty two entries.

Parse metadata records only an entry count. A builder pairs a fixed array of one leaf layout with such metadata. Single and counted wrappers reuse that pair, and the counted form enforces build time lower and upper size limits. The present container holds only the first two base functions inside an outer table.
Counted leaves require at least two entries and at most the span between family specific first and last subleaf markers inclusive.

Online query and mask clear helpers have two build dependent forms. One form tests or clears the bit in a mask structure with a range check, while the constrained form treats only processor zero as online and clearing as a no operation.
Offline test is the unlikely negation of the online query.

Crash reservation alignment is sixteen megabytes. Address caps have a small build with both limits at five hundred twelve megabytes and a large build with low limit at four gigabytes and high limit at sixty four terabytes.

Default low reservation helper yields zero on narrow builds and otherwise the larger of a platform supplied size plus eight megabytes versus two hundred fifty six megabytes. A marker advertises early reservation table support.
Current task accessor selects a constant percpu read when segment support is configured and a stable percpu read otherwise, with a short alias exposing the same query.
Debug control keeps a single architecturally fixed set bit at position ten with all other fixed bits clear.
Debug access macros forward reads and writes to native helpers. Native helpers transfer values for registers zero to three and six to seven and fault on any other selector.

Seventh control register transfers forbid compiler reordering because under encrypted guests they can raise a nested exception that is unsafe inside entry or nonmaskable paths before guest state is entered.
Unsupported debug selector causes an immediate fault in both read and write paths.
Disable helper restores control to its fixed pattern and clears four address registers. Activity test checks global enable bits in the percpu control copy.

Breakpoint save returns zero immediately on hypervisors when inactive, otherwise captures control masks the fixed bit disables when any other bit was set behind a compiler barrier and returns the prior value. Restore issues a barrier and rewrites the saved value only when nonzero, so zero means no state to restore.

Address mask helpers are empty with reads returning zero. Debug control register helpers bypass access on early processor generations without dedicated support and otherwise move the full register value to or from the caller.
Global table page holds a fixed architectural count of descriptors aligned to page size.

Local entry builder derives limit base access width and granularity fields from user supplied limit base permission content presence usability width and paging inputs, forces system user readable settings and clears long mode.

Writable accessors return the per processor or current processor table base. Read only accessors return the entry area mapping for a chosen or current processor. A physical helper translates the writable base to its address.

Gate builder distributes a handler address across low middle and where applicable high portions while setting present privilege type stack selection and segment fields with word width dependent segment handling. Empty test succeeds only when both halves of a descriptor read zero.

Table management exposes task global interrupt local store and thread local load operations plus local global and interrupt entry writers, all forwarding to native or direct register transfers, with empty virtualized allocation hooks.
Native table writers copy a full gate or an eight byte descriptor into the selected slot, and local table selector can be read directly.
Each header defines a distinct inclusion guard preventing repeated processing.
